method: Read every docs/ file (design, plan, tickets) of v2a/v2b/v2c in full and REPORT.md; reused the 41-situation vocabulary and counting rule of variance-check.json (present if a failure row, grid cell or guarantee states handling and/or an acceptance item covers it). Added 6 situations that NEW runs introduced and grepped all 9 runs for them (OLD none; MID v1b N1/N3/N5, v1c N4/N5, stated only). For NEW, 'stated' = handled in design text/grid/guarantee or an acceptance item; 'tested' = an acceptance item (Gxx/Ay) actually exercises it. A grid citation to an item that does not test the claim counts as stated, not tested. The '(tested)' PII-to-model item requires a test for both. MID re-checked by grep spot checks (v1a: no proposal-expiry and no call-cap test; v1c: no customer-text injection; all MID cancel-all only via injected staff text) - all consistent with the earlier file. Known-gap scoring: 1 present, 0.5 partial, 0 absent.

check_schedule_NEW.how: Copied each v2x/H4 docs/ and .claude/ to scratchpad/est/r11tmp (deleted afterwards); ran python3.12 -I .claude/skills/adk-system-designer/scripts/check_schedule.py --plan --tickets --design (script identical to the repo copy), once bare and once with each plan's own --days/--reserve/--person.

v2a.own_args: --days 10, 3x3.6 h: exit 1 only because calendar fits at low end only (9.15-13.67 d); matches plan

v2b.own_args: --days 10, 3x5 h: exit 1 only for calendar (9.13-13.87 d); matches plan

check_schedule_NEW.summary: No grid, ticket/plan or citation problems reported in any NEW run. The checker only proves a cited item exists, not that it tests the claim (see grid_audit_NEW).

cited_item_does_not_test_claim: Cloud SQL x credential expired -> G05/A6 (tests 'Postgres unavailable', not a revoked credential)
Cloud SQL x rate limited -> G05/A6 (pool exhaustion untested)
weak: Booking API writes x partial and Move x partially applied -> G04/A11, G01/A2, G06/A1 verify only the atomic-reschedule assumption; the book-then-cancel partial state is in OD2 with no item

wrong_na: Vertex AI x credential expired: 'n/a: workload identity, no stored key' - the service account's Vertex grant can still be revoked; the same run tests a revoked Cloud SQL grant (G08/A7)
cited_item_does_not_test_claim: Cloud SQL x write outcome unknown -> G04/A6 (booking-API lost response / crash before recording; DB commit-ack loss not tested)
Cloud SQL x untrusted content -> G03/A5, G07/A1 (test injected booking-API note text, not stored session history replayed into the prompt, which the change table gives as the reason)

wrong_na: Cloud SQL x untrusted content: 'n/a: own schema only' - stored session events are replayed into the model (v2a and v2b both cite tests for it) [questionable]
Gemini x duplicate/concurrent: 'n/a: stateless model calls' - overlapping turns are handled, but under the Cloud SQL row (G03/A7) [questionable, harmless]

grid_audit_NEW.comparison_MID: MID: 18 bare n/a, 7 empty cells (v1a), 43/81 (53%) cited cells backed by a matching test. NEW: 0 bare n/a, 0 empty, 130/130 cite an existing acceptance item, 126/130 (97%) actually test the claim.
grid_audit_NEW.grid_words_note: Failure section (grids + scenarios) mean 588 words NEW vs 794 MID vs 311 OLD: cell text is now short citations, so the section shrank vs MID.

v2a.settled: all 17 per REPORT; 12 change-table rows (several group findings)
v2a.effect: finish moved from fits-at-low-end/high day 11 to needing 14 working days; 4 grid citations corrected; new acceptance G04/A13, A14, G02/A8

v2b.settled: all; each traceable to a change-table row
v2b.effect: finish 7.73-11.2 -> 9.13-13.87 d; new G09 integration goal, waits W2/W3; grid fixes added G05/A10, G04/A11, G08/A7

v2c.evidence: Plan 'Changes after failing runs and after the independent review' with Review P1-P14, V2-V8, C1-C5 cited; REPORT: '14 prerequisite findings, 1 on settled mentions, 5 on claims and 8 on coverage. Each was settled'.
v2c.settled: 27 traceable (P1-P14, C1-C5, V2-V8, mentions paragraph); V1 is not cited anywhere in the plan
v2c.effect: plan that fit at 9.9 d no longer fits 10 (11.7 high); added W0, W2, G09 launch split, kill switch G03/A9, G04/A12, G07/A8

independent_review_NEW.summary: Review ran in all three NEW runs (17/25/28 findings), was settled in a change table each time and moved the finish later every time. No run did a second review after the fixes.

lengths.summary: Design+plan: OLD 6171, MID 7198 (+17%), NEW 7871 (+28% vs OLD, +9% vs MID). Tickets: OLD 3308, MID 3080, NEW 4337 (+41% vs MID). Acceptance items nearly double: 37 (MID) -> 70 per run.

verdict.more_complete: Yes. Mean situations per run (47-item vocabulary): OLD 25.3, MID 37.0, NEW 44.3 stated / 41.7 tested by a real acceptance item. Known gaps (10 items): OLD 8.0, MID 7.3, NEW 9.8; v2b and v2c close all ten, v2a misses only the non-atomic partial-move path.
verdict.more_consistent: Yes, sharply. Present in all three runs: OLD 20, MID 30, NEW 42 stated / 37 tested. Mean pairwise Jaccard: OLD 0.77, MID 0.76 (0.81 on the old 41), NEW 0.94 stated / 0.88 tested. Only 1 situation is in a single NEW run (customer-message length cap, v2c) against 9 in MID.
verdict.why: The action grid (over-broad, partial, stale confirmation, unknown outcome, repeated) brought back the product-level rows MID lost (customer cancel-all, proposal expiry, call-cap, staff-changed appointment, wrong target), and the cite-an-item rule plus the review turned claims into acceptance items (acceptance items 37 (MID) -> 70 per run).
what_remains: Variance now sits in decisions, not coverage: v2a assumes atomic reschedule (partial state only an open decision); v2c pilots one salon, v2a/v2b launch five; models differ (3.5 vs 3.8 flash).

Never tested in any NEW run: pinned-model retirement (stated only). Tested in only one or two: relative-date/DST (v2c), message-length cap (v2c only), tampered payload (v2a, v2b), PII-to-model minimisation (v2a, v2c), JWKS key rotation (v2a, v2b), staging notifications to real people (v2a, v2c).

4 of 130 grid citations still point at items that do not test the claim (all Cloud SQL rows: credential, rate limit, commit-unknown, replayed history); 1 wrong n/a (v2b Vertex credential) and 2 questionable (v2c). The checker cannot see these; only the review catches them, and no run re-reviewed after fixing.
Most acceptance items are planned offline tests against fakes; real-dependency evidence is limited to one staging drill per run.

Cost: tickets +41% words and ~2x acceptance items vs MID; design+plan +9%. Every NEW plan finishes after the 10-day target at the high end (13.7, 13.9, 11.7 days), partly because the review exposed missing waits.
verdict.caveat: One analyst, one pass of reading; NEW was scored with stated/tested split, OLD/MID with the earlier present rule. Small n (3 per set).
